rules.mlShapeSignalPriority: promotion tier -> model confidence -> market edge -> margin support
rules.mlShapeConflictPolicy: High margin support does not override low confidence; high confidence with thin margin is a closer-score win profile.
rules.promotedF5Ml: F5 ML confidence-first promotion: edge >=0.5, lead confidence >=52, tiePct <20; edge >=1.5 is strong-edge support, not a demotion
rules.promotedTeamTotal: F5 team total confidence >=65 or <60 seed only when discrete hit-threshold cushion >=0.75 runs; watch thin threshold cushions even when raw line edge looks large
